purpose: Separate verifier-confirmed code semantics from strict whole-file harness compatibility without changing the primary benchmark outcome.

development_smoke_origin.reason: The smoke motivated this secondary protocol. Its 12/12 post-hoc result remains separately labeled and cannot enter the formal comparison.

interpretation_limit: This diagnostic can show that exact candidate code passes the current verifier after a narrowly defined transport transformation. It cannot convert a malformed source response into an automated end-to-end success, estimate reliability or justify arbitrary response repair.
